name: colombia-payroll
description: Colombian payroll for employers in 2026 (nómina): the 2026 minimum wage of COP 1,750,905 (Decreto 1469 de 2025) and transport aid of COP 249,095 (Decreto 1470 de 2025); health 12.5% (8.5% employer, 4% employee) and pension 16% (12% employer, 4% employee) under Ley 100 de 1993, the Fondo de Solidaridad Pensional from 4 SMMLV, the IBC floor of 1 and cap of 25 SMMLV, the 40% cap on non-salary payments, ARL classes I to V, parafiscales (caja 4%, SENA 2%, ICBF 3%), the art. 114-1 ET exoneration for workers under 10 SMMLV, salario integral, retención en la fuente on wages under art. 383 ET with procedimiento 1 and 2, prestaciones sociales (cesantías, intereses, prima, vacaciones), PILA and Form 350 deadlines, electronic payroll and UGPP penalties. Trigger on: nómina Colombia 2026, salario mínimo 2026, aportes parafiscales, exoneración 114-1, retención en la fuente salarios, procedimiento 1 o 2, PILA, cesantías, prima de servicios, salario integral, Colombian payroll, employer cost Colombia.
